title: [CQ-M01e] Profile readiness admission
description:
Objective: Apply one fail-closed effective-profile admission rule consistently to explicit claims, ranked work and waiters.

Deliverable: Reuse resolveTaskExecutionProfile and assertExecutionProfileReady for explicit task claims, ranked candidate pools, own-seat resumes and wait_for_task matching. An unavailable strict task must not be assigned or have its existing attempt closed; explicit calls return a concrete refusal, and ranked/wait pools must not produce wake-claim-refuse spin. Read stored strict snapshots even when current project selection rolls back. Coordinate with the task-store progression backstop from M01c; no environment, missing-identity compatibility branch or direct project-file setting may silently launch strict work through native/legacy execution.

Existing implementation surfaces / proposed focused tests (maximum five files): packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/executionProfile.ts; packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/executionProfile.test.ts; packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/claimNextTask.ts; packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/waitForTask.ts; proposed new packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/executionProfileAdmission.test.ts.

NOT in scope: Certifying/starting VMs, changing existing legacy assignment/finalizing/reconciliation semantics, implementing session receipts, approved revision proof, or weakening old held-out delivery tests. Verification (fresh, exit 0): cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test -- --maxWorkers=4. Run in a synchronized isolated copy with native Linux dependencies and Linux-only PATH; preserve the original Windows node_modules and unchanged package-lock.json. Each slice owns its behavior tests, one final verification/adversarial review, and no production activation. This breakdown defines deliverables, not per-task implementation steps.
definitionOfDone: Explicit unavailable-profile claims fail with concrete readiness reasons before assignment, attempt closure/open, worker changes or other side effects.
Ranked claim and waiter integration tests agree on eligibility, preventing wake/refuse loops for unavailable strict work.
Own-seat resume and project rollback cannot bypass a stored strict profile; malformed profile/snapshot records fail closed.
Absent/legacy/observe task admission and existing finalizing/reconciliation holds remain compatible.
No environment/caller readiness label or native execution fallback can make verified-local available; cleanup/read-only diagnostics remain accessible.
Fresh `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test -- --maxWorkers=4` exits 0 in the synchronized native-Linux copy, with actual pass/skip counts and output supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: Do not enable verified-local or claim approval, runner trust, hardware/isolation certification, or verified completion from a configuration snapshot.
Do not edit packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/acceptance.test.ts or weaken existing held-out delivery assertions; add focused tests for new behavior.
No direct .moe edits or Git writes; wrappers own landing. Keep each implementation plan within five source/test files and normal sizing limits.
